schema:name: Chernonozhkin et al. (2021) Pallasite Olivine 2D Mapping v1
schema:description: laicpmsTAPP instance derived from Chernonozhkin et al. 2021 (Chem Geol 562) Pallasite olivine Raster mapping (2D) ns-LA-SF-ICP-MS Ghent University (column N of LA-Q_SF-ICPMS_TAPP_v2.xlsx 'TAPP' worksheet).

schema:location.schema:name: Dept. of Chemistry, Atomic & Mass Spectrometry, Ghent University, Belgium

ada:sampleFormAnalyticalSubstrateDefault: In situ — polished epoxy thick section (HELEX II two-volume cell)
ada:samplePreparationMethodDefault: PMG thick sections polished; HELEX II two-volume cell; C-coated for SEM then coating removed before LA
ada:laserManufacturerModel: Teledyne CETAC Technologies Analyte G2 (193 nm ArF excimer)
ada:icpMsType: Double-focusing sector field ICP-MS (explicitly stated: "Thermo Scientific Element XR double-focusing sector field ICP-MS unit")
ada:interfaceConeConfiguration: Al standard sample cone (1.1 mm aperture); Al H-type skimmer (0.8 mm aperture)
ada:laserWavelengthAndType: 193 nm ArF excimer; pulse duration ~5 ns
ada:rasterLineSpacingDefault: 20 µm (contiguous; 20×20 µm square spot = line spacing equals spot width)
ada:carrierGasAndFlowRateDefault: He: MFC-1 (cell) 0.200–0.260 l min⁻¹; MFC-2 (cup) 0.220–0.385 l min⁻¹
ada:plasmaThermalMode: Cool plasma (800 W RF) to reduce Ar-based argide interferences on ⁶⁰Ni and ⁷¹Ga
ada:oxideProductionMethodAndThreshold: ThO⁺/Th⁺ (mass 248/232); threshold not explicitly stated but minimized by cool plasma
ada:analysisSequenceDefault: (i) Gas blanks → (ii) all glass GRMs for external calibration → (iii) 1–3 cosmic spherule unknowns → (iv) blanks → (v) all glass GRMs again
ada:backgroundCountTimeDefault: Scans for gas blank: 10 per line (before each mapping line); 80 scans during ablation
ada:internalStandardApproach: Sum-of-major-oxide normalization: MgO+FeO+SiO₂+P₂O₅ = 100 wt% per pixel (Liu et al. 2008 approach; no EPMA required for IS)
ada:internalStandardElement: No single IS element; oxide sum normalization (MgO+FeO+SiO₂+P₂O₅) used as virtual IS per pixel
ada:elementalFractionationCorrection: Internal normalization to MgO+FeO+SiO₂+P₂O₅ oxide sum corrects for point-to-point ablation yield variation; additional pixel-by-pixel normalization fixes oxide sum to 100 wt%
ada:signalIntegrationIntervalMethod: Manual visual inspection of time-resolved signal per line; anomalous spikes (inclusions, cracks, veinlets) excluded; P-rich veinlet regions identified and excluded from olivine averages
ada:blankBackgroundCorrectionMethod: Gas blank measured before each ablation line (10 scans of gas blank per mapping line); average background subtracted from each corresponding ablation line
ada:primaryCalibrationStandardNameDefaul: Multiple glass GRMs used together for linear regression external calibration: NIST SRM 612, NIST SRM 614, USGS GSD-1G (synthetic), USGS GSE-1G (synthetic), USGS BHVO-2G, USGS BIR-1G (natural basalt glasses)
ada:secondaryReferenceMaterialsDefault: MPI-DING glasses: GOR132-G, StHs6/80-G, T1-G; USGS: BCR-2G, BHVO-2G — measured as unknowns alongside samples and compared to GeoReM preferred values (Table 1 and Section 3.3)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Transect Rate, Mapping Rate or Step Size
Plasma / Make-up Gas Addition
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Ar make-up: 0.81–0.99 l min⁻¹ (mapping); N₂ explicitly not added

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Auxiliary and Cool Gas Flow Rates
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Cool: 15 l min⁻¹ Ar; Auxiliary: 0.81 l min⁻¹ (mapping)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Signal Smoothing
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: None (no signal smoothing device; N₂ not added)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: ICP Tuning
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Daily tuning; cool plasma conditions optimized; N₂ explicitly not added to avoid N-based interferences

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Drift Monitor Frequency
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Each GRM analyzed 3–5× before and 3–5× after sample analyses (all GRMs at start and end of session)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Manual identification and exclusion of P-rich veinlet pixels from olivine averages; anomalous spikes from inclusions excluded per line

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Pulse/Analog Detector Nonlinearity Correction
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Applied: triple mode detection; cross-calibration between pulse-counting and analog modes performed

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Memory Effect Mitigation
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Gas blank measured before each ablation line; adequate washout ensured by duty cycle timing

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: 100% oxide sum normalization (MgO+FeO+SiO₂+P₂O₅) applied per pixel after IS-normalized external calibration (equations 3–4 in Appendix C1) to fix final mass balance

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Additional Notes
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Pallasite olivine 2D mapping in cool plasma mode (800 W) is a core methodological innovation; total of 8 PMG meteorites mapped; P-rich veinlets excluded from olivine averages; Fa# values verified against EMPA (Fig. 5A)

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: Analyzed constituent
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: Analyzed constituent (isotope) identified by the analyte row.
